title: Provisional ball and penalty areas
question: If your ball goes into a penalty area, such as a pond marked with red stakes, can you decide to play a provisional ball?

choices.text: Yes, you can always play a provisional ball in any situation.
No, you cannot play a provisional ball if your ball might be in a penalty area.
Yes, but only if your ball is not found.
Only if you are playing in a team competition.

explanation: You are not allowed to play a provisional ball when your ball is likely in a penalty area. Instead, you must use the penalty relief options.
